state: Can compiles to TypeScript on pinned Bun 1.4.2. B1-12 exposes Markdown rendering. Bun.markdown.html returns ordinary strings and preserves script markup plus javascript: URLs by default; noHtmlBlocks and noHtmlSpans escape raw HTML instead. Bun.markdown.render takes synchronous string-transformer callbacks composed by concatenation: text arrives raw and unescaped, heading carries level, link carries href and title, image carries src and title, code carries language or null, while codespan, strong, emphasis, strikethrough, paragraph, blockquote and hr carry children only. Three structural gaps are pinned: list fires once per level with items flattened beyond recovery carrying only ordered and depth, table fires once with rows and cells flattened, and line breaks fire nothing. Raw HTML blocks reach the html callback; raw spans arrive as plain text. Unknown constructs such as footnotes degrade to text, NUL splits text with U+FFFD so callback text never contains NUL, callback throws propagate unwrapped, and unknown options or callbacks are ignored. The existing html.ts factory builds typed html::safe through async text, makeTag, element, textAttribute, urlAttribute, parseURL and fragment calls; response_html accepts only html::safe. Its authorTags allowlist lacks code, pre, blockquote, img and del, voidTags lacks img, and urlAttribute plus the element URL map lack src; parseURL admits only https and local URLs and rejects control bytes, backslashes and credentials. Because native callbacks are synchronous and the factory is async, safe construction runs in two phases: sync capture of tag trees with a NUL-token alphabet the native layer guarantees unforgeable, then async validated construction reusing the factory. Adapter law forbids regex-sanitized HTML branded safe and forbids stringified Promises. Budgets default to standaloneBytes elsewhere in the codecs.

safe_mode_scope.instructions: What safe HTML scope should B1-12 ship?

criteria.blocked: Ship string rendering only and keep typed safe mode blocked with a reproducer, because lists and tables cannot round-trip through callbacks.
criteria.safe_subset: Ship a prose-plus-code safe renderer covering headings, paragraphs, quotes, spans, code, links and images, rejecting lists, tables and raw blocks fail-closed.
criteria.full_flattened: Ship full safe rendering that flattens lists and tables into paragraphs, preserving text while dropping their structure silently.

raw_block_policy.instructions: How should safe mode treat raw HTML blocks?

criteria.reject: Fail the render with an unsupported-element error naming the raw block.
criteria.escape_paragraph: Escape the block text and emit it as a visible paragraph, preserving content with altered structure.
criteria.strip_silent: Drop raw blocks from the output without an error.

budget_shape.instructions: How should render budgets be set?

criteria.fixed_standalone: Fixed standaloneBytes input and output caps inside the adapter, mirroring the document codecs.
criteria.caller_limits: Caller-supplied options and limits records validated per call for input bytes, output bytes and element counts.
